description: This Java class defines the VehicleService, a service layer component responsible for CRUD operations and business logic related to Vehicle entities in a fleet management system. It includes methods for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting vehicles, with validation and exception handling.

classes.name: VehicleService
classes.description: Service layer class providing CRUD operations and business logic for Vehicle entities, including validation and exception handling.

methods.name: listVehicles
methods.description: Returns a list of all vehicles from the repository.

methods.name: getVehicle
methods.description: Retrieves a vehicle by its ID, throwing ResourceNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: createVehicle
methods.description: Creates a new vehicle entity from a request payload, ensuring uniqueness and logging the process.

methods.name: updateVehicle
methods.description: Updates an existing vehicle's details, ensuring uniqueness constraints and logging the process.

methods.name: deleteVehicle
methods.description: Deletes a vehicle by its ID, throwing exception if the vehicle does not exist.
